verdict.rationale: Skyvern is built around natural-language operation. Tasks take a plain-language goal prompt plus a starting URL [skyvern-docs-18], and the SDK adds natural-language act/extract/validate commands on top of Playwright [skyvern-docs-19]. Plain-English SOP upload builds workflows [skyvern-docs-24], a Copilot chat builds and debugs them interactively [skyvern-docs-25], and an MCP server lets AI assistants drive the browser [skyvern-docs-7]; hands-on users confirm it works on the happy path but stumbles on some complex sites [skyvern-comm-2]. Missing for 10: independent evidence that natural-language commands execute reliably beyond happy-path cases.
